changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwaplovvalues AS SELECT alv.key, alv.lov_key, alv.lov_code, alv.value_code, alv.lov_display_vale, alv.love_custom_code, alv.value_description, alv.value_color, alv.value_icon, alv.value_order, alv.isdefault, alv.seeded_data, alv.for_internal_user, alv.specific_for_screen_id, alv.parent_value_id, alv.created_by, alv.updated_by, alv.deleted_by, alv.created_at, alv.updated_at, alv.deleted_at, alv.is_valid, alv.score FROM public.ap_lov_values alv;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwaplovvalues TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwaplovvalues FROM report_user;
